components.name: Image prompt composer
components.description: Persistent prompt and reference tray with one primary generate action; exact dimensions and model selection remain in the optional settings panel.

components.name: Clip length
components.description: Visible Use source and Custom buttons with selected, disabled and focus states.

narrative.northStar: A quiet canvas for making images and videos
narrative.overview: The user-approved Artify direction uses a charcoal workspace, acid-lime primary action, compact tools, a persistent prompt and saved dark/light appearance. Image and Video are the clear starting choices; advanced controls stay available without dominating the canvas.
keyCharacteristics: Simple Image and Video entry points
Large preview canvas with compact settings

rules.name: Honest progress
rules.body: Show progress for the active stage only. Label estimated remaining time as an estimate and use indeterminate progress when a stage cannot report completion.

rules.name: Keep the prompt central
rules.body: The prompt and references remain together beside the primary generate action. Technical settings stay in the compact, optional settings surface.

dos: Keep the preview and prompt in view
Retain native labels, keyboard focus and graph access
Show actual user media in references and results
donts: Do not fill the canvas with promotional text or placeholder cards
Do not imply unavailable browser verification
Do not hide the prompt behind advanced settings
